lines.t: Last night... we faced the hidden things
The corners of the heart, yeah
I laid my blind spots at Your feet
I woke before the morning light
Water falling... and the tears the same
So tired of this broken world
No words would form, I couldn't speak
I felt myself begin to fall...
I was BREAKING in Your arms
My thirsty soul cried out Your name
I saw You in the distance...
And I yearned.. I longed for your embrace!
White robes in a far-off light
I wrapped my arms around the One
I kissed the holes within Your hands,
I couldn't bare what they've done to you!
The bursting of my heart... the cry! My soul longs for you!
I watched You lifted high until the sky grew dark
I wept like I was standing there, HELPLESS in my love!
The moment stood sill in the silence of your death...
I wept! I cried! My soul yearned - as I watch you die...
You said the power of Your rising
I was BREAKING in Your arms
And now I know I never leave
